lastMessage:
chore: standardize all versions to x.x.0 semantic format

- Renamed 63 widget version files from vX.Y to vX.Y.0 format
- Updated version strings in 33+ widget HTML files (Version: headers)
- Updated @version tags in 10+ script files (manifest generators, watchers)
- Updated all documentation references to use x.x.0 format
- Created automation tools: standardize-versions.js and rename-widget-versions.js
- Added npm scripts: versions:standardize, versions:check, versions:rename, versions:rename-check
- Created comprehensive version-standardization-guide.md documentation
- Fixes dropdown sorting issues (v1.10.0 now properly sorts after v1.9.0)
- Maintains Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 compliance throughout repository
\n\nAuthor: mccal
